title: Naturally Sweet Brazilian Feta Pudding
description: A traditional Brazilian dessert featuring feta cheese, this pudding is a yeasty and glassy-jelly treat that is lacto-vegetarian friendly. It is topped with a sweet glaze and is a nostalgic favorite.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yeast and 1 cup of warm milk, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Let the yeast mixture sit for 5 minutes until it becomes frothy.
In a medium saucepan, combine the remaining 1 cup of milk, sugar, and crumbled feta cheese.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring until the sugar has dissolved and the cheese is melted.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the yeast mixture and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
Add the softened gelatin to the cooled mixture and stir until it is fully dissolved.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups and refrigerate until set.
To make the glaze, whisk together the powdered sugar and milk until smooth.
Drizzle the glaze over the chilled pudding before serving.
